</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=669" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 101

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Maul](/Weapons.aspx?ID=388)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The putrid stench emanating from the [catoblepas](/Monsters.aspx?ID=579) antlers adorning this _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [greater crushing](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1298) [maul](/Weapons.aspx?ID=388)_ interferes with your sense of smell. While wielding this weapon, you gain a +2 item bonus to saves against [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664) effects.

**Activate—Vile Stench** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664))   **Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with the _catoblepas maul_; **Effect** The target must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or become [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1 (plus [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for as long as it’s sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save becomes temporarily immune to Vile Stench for 1 minute.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include antlers from a [catoblepas](/Monsters.aspx?ID=579).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
